documents.title: The Factories Act, 1948
documents.extracted_text: An Act to consolidate and amend the law regulating labour in factories. Contains provisions regarding health, safety, welfare, working hours of adults, employment of young persons, and annual leave with wages in manufacturing facilities.
documents.extracted_summary: Comprehensive legislation governing health, safety, working conditions, overtime regulations, and welfare amenities for industrial workers across Indian manufacturing premises.

key_sections.title: General duties of the occupier
key_sections.obligation: Ensure health, safety, and welfare of all workers in factory

key_sections.title: Cleanliness
key_sections.obligation: Maintain cleanliness and disposal of industrial wastes

key_sections.title: Fencing of machinery
key_sections.obligation: Secure fencing of dangerous transmission machinery

documents.title: The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (CPCB)
documents.extracted_text: An Act to provide for the protection and improvement of environment and for matters connected therewith. Formulates environmental quality standards, emission thresholds, hazardous substance handling restrictions, and environmental clearance mandates.
documents.extracted_summary: Umbrella environmental protection legislation setting emissions limits, effluent discharge guidelines, mandatory Environmental Clearances (EC), and hazardous waste oversight.

key_sections.title: Persons carrying on industry not to allow emission in excess of standards
key_sections.obligation: Discharge emissions strictly within CPCB permissible limits

key_sections.title: Furnishing of information to authorities
key_sections.obligation: Immediate notification in event of environmental accidents

documents.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP)
documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
documents.extracted_text: An Act to provide for the processing of digital personal data in a manner that recognises both the right of individuals to protect their personal data and the need to process such personal data for lawful purposes.
documents.extracted_summary: National data privacy governance act mandating consent architectures, data fiduciary duties, security safeguards, breach reporting to the Data Protection Board, and cross-border transfer parameters.

key_sections.title: Consent and Notice Requirements
key_sections.obligation: Obtain unambiguous, freely given, specific consent with clear purpose notice

key_sections.title: General obligations of Data Fiduciary
key_sections.obligation: Implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach

documents.title: Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Amendment Rules, 2021
documents.extracted_text: Rules governing CSR expenditure, impact assessment requirements for projects over 1 Crore, registration of implementing agencies (Form CSR-1), and unspent CSR account treatment.
documents.extracted_summary: Corporate governance statutory rules detailing mandatory CSR expenditure schedules, impact assessment guidelines, board disclosures, and unspent CSR transfers.

key_sections.title: CSR Implementation
key_sections.obligation: Mandatory Form CSR-1 registration with MCA for implementing agencies

key_sections.title: CSR Reporting
key_sections.obligation: Annual board report on CSR activities with detailed Annexure disclosures
